for: SBDC AI directors and the people who run AI at their center
badge: SBDC AI Admin Kit · MIT licensed
setup_lead: On ChatGPT, do row 1. Rows 2 to 4 are other ways, if you have them.
chatgpt_fallback: paste the skill text into a ChatGPT Project's instructions.

doors.heading: Which one is you?
buttons: I have thirty GPTs to sort, or no button

doors.title: Door 1: You have the button
steps: Press Migrate on the GPTs people use. One click each.
Test each one cold before advisors touch it: fresh chat, TESTING.md, throw the ugly stuff at it. About ten minutes per GPT.
Want a receipt of which rules survived? Run the same GPT through GPT to Skill; its ledger is the receipt, and the button doesn't give you one. About ten minutes per GPT.

receipt.caption: This is what you get for each GPT. The full one is in the worked example.
rows: "If the ID code is not present, use 'Client ID' — never guess one."
"match these Neoserra categories exactly, do not paraphrase"
Suggested: never paste a client's SSN, date of birth, or account numbers into the drafted email
Not in the skill until you say yes
"read the attached SKILL.md in full and follow it exactly"
Points at a Knowledge file that wasn't attached; attach it and re-run

doors.have: the migrated plugins your advisors use, a pass/fail sheet per GPT, and, if you did step 3, a ledger per GPT.
doors.policy: Advisors stay on the button's plugin. The converted skill is your receipt and your test sheet.

doors.title: Door 2: Thirty to sort, or no button
steps: Attach your GPT files (Word is fine; one per GPT, named for the GPT), ten per message. The skill builds my-gpts.md and hands it back. No file comes back? Paste them into one Word document, ## and the name above each.

Put the skill where you work: paste skills/gpt-to-skill/SKILL.md into a new ChatGPT Project's instructions, upload its references and scripts folders, then say Triage my GPTs. About five minutes. Details on the GPT to Skill page.

Read the table. Skill and Plugin are keepers; Merge and Retire are your call. Have the button? Press it on the keepers and go to door 1, step 2. No button? Convert one per chat with the cards; each comes back with a receipt.
doors.have: a 30-row table with a verdict per GPT, a card per keeper, and my-gpts.md to keep.

doors.shelf: The shelf: STANDARD.md (ten pass/fail lines; needs the skill's text in front of you) · TESTING.md · the worked example (a real conversion, scored honestly: a narrow FAIL, and the list of what to check by hand) · the guide generator (optional) · Written for Maryland and points at Neoserra; check anything that touches your own CRM. MIT and unsupported; fork it.
